Settings label: 'Keep the Powered by WP Sell Services credit off the vendor dashboard' with description explicitly noting 'The credit is already hidden on every site, so this changes nothing unless your theme or a snippet switches it on with wpss_show_powered_by.' Verified against code: Free's UnifiedDashboard.php defaults apply_filters('wpss_show_powered_by', false) to false already; Pro's DashboardBrandingService::filter_show_powered_by() only forces it false when hide_branding is on - matching the label's scope (frontend vendor dashboard) exactly. failures.expected: Each message bubble's author label shows the member's display name (e.g. 'Ella Fixed').
failures.actual: Every text-only evidence/message entry with no attachment shows the literal word 'Attachment' as the author name instead of the sender's name. Reproduced live: opened a fresh dispute as buyer Ella and vendor Sofia both saw the opening statement bubble labelled 'Attachment' instead of 'Ella Fixed'.
failures.root_cause: $ev_name is set correctly to the member display name, then unconditionally overwritten two lines later by $ev_name = wpss_format_attachment_name(...) followed by a fallback to the literal string 'Attachment' when there is no attachment on the row - this logic was written for filename display but reuses the same variable that also holds the author name.
failures.evidence: Live: dashboard/disputes/?dispute=92 and ?dispute=93, both parties, both showed 'Attachment' as author. Code: templates/dashboard/sections/disputes.php lines ~240-247.

failures.expected: After picking an additional gallery image, its 'Remove this image' icon-only button renders a visible Lucide icon, exactly like the equivalent buttons for extras/FAQs/deliverables/requirements (all of which call refreshIcons() after their add-methods).
failures.actual: The gallery-images push in openMediaUploader() never calls this.refreshIcons(), so a newly added gallery image's remove button keeps the raw <i data-lucide="x-circle"> placeholder instead of the rendered <svg> - an empty 40px box with no visible way to remove the row, matching the exact historical bug pattern (1.6.0 changelog) already fixed for extras/FAQ/deliverables but missed here.
failures.root_cause: addFeature(), addRequirement(), addExtra(), addFaq() all end with this.refreshIcons(); the gallery-images push inside the frame.on('select', ...) callback in openMediaUploader() does not.

verdict.summary: All 14 items in the 1.7.2 diff behave correctly per their spec, verified via a mix of live browser exercise (with fixtures created and fully cleaned up), server-side DB confirmation, and source-code review where a live walk was impractical (recurring-services, off by design) or could not be reliably captured (the 2-second contact-seller success window). Two real, reproducible soft bugs were found and are NOT release-blocking: F1 (dispute evidence author label shows the word 'Attachment' instead of the sender's name when there is no file attached) and F2 (a newly added gallery image's remove-icon does not render because the gallery-add path is missing the refreshIcons() call every sibling add-method already has). Both are small, isolated, one-line-class fixes. No hard fails, no fatals, no unexplained debug.log entries, no unguarded REST routes, no i18n regressions. The only unresolved question from this pass is a rail-identity value flip (standalone -> auto) observed mid-session whose cause could not be isolated - it did not block or corrupt anything, but is worth a second look before shipping given the runbook's explicit warning about rail-related false bounces.
